connection_requests_response_consistent.name: connection_requests_response_consistent
connection_requests_response_consistent.value: (`connection_requests`.`status` = 'pending' and `connection_requests`.`responded_at` is null) or (`connection_requests`.`status` <> 'pending' and `connection_requests`.`responded_at` is not null)

stored_files_dimensions_complete.name: stored_files_dimensions_complete
stored_files_dimensions_complete.value: (`stored_files`.`width` is null and `stored_files`.`height` is null) or (`stored_files`.`width` > 0 and `stored_files`.`height` > 0)

user_connections_has_source.name: user_connections_has_source
user_connections_has_source.value: `user_connections`.`manual_connected_at` is not null or `user_connections`.`workspace_connected_at` is not null

workspace_invitations_acceptance_consist.name: workspace_invitations_acceptance_consistent
workspace_invitations_acceptance_consist.value: (`workspace_invitations`.`status` = 'accepted') = (`workspace_invitations`.`accepted_at` is not null and `workspace_invitations`.`accepted_by_user_id` is not null)

social_post_blocks_content_consistent.name: social_post_blocks_content_consistent
social_post_blocks_content_consistent.value:
(`social_post_blocks`.`kind` = 'text' and nullif(btrim(coalesce(`social_post_blocks`.`text_content`, '')), '') is not null and `social_post_blocks`.`file_id` is null)
        or (`social_post_blocks`.`kind` in ('image', 'video') and `social_post_blocks`.`file_id` is not null and `social_post_blocks`.`text_content` is null)

projects_dates_ordered.name: projects_dates_ordered
projects_dates_ordered.value: `projects`.`start_date` is null or `projects`.`end_date` is null or `projects`.`end_date` >= `projects`.`start_date`

financial_entries_source_consistent.name: financial_entries_source_consistent
financial_entries_source_consistent.value:
(`financial_entries`.`source` = 'manual' and `financial_entries`.`project_id` is null and `financial_entries`.`project_installment_id` is null)
        or (`financial_entries`.`source` = 'project' and `financial_entries`.`project_id` is not null and `financial_entries`.`project_installment_id` is not null)

financial_entries_series_consistent.name: financial_entries_series_consistent
financial_entries_series_consistent.value:
(`financial_entries`.`series_kind` is null and `financial_entries`.`series_id` is null and `financial_entries`.`series_number` is null and `financial_entries`.`series_count` is null)
        or (`financial_entries`.`series_kind` in ('installment', 'recurrence') and `financial_entries`.`series_id` is not null and `financial_entries`.`series_number` between 1 and 999 and `financial_entries`.`series_count` between 1 and 999 and `financial_entries`.`series_number` <= `financial_entries`.`series_count`)

tasks_board_order_shape.name: tasks_board_order_shape
tasks_board_order_shape.value:
jsonb_typeof(`tasks`.`board_order`) = 'object'
        and `tasks`.`board_order` - 'status' - 'priority' - 'business' - 'project' = '{}'::jsonb
        and (not (`tasks`.`board_order` ? 'status') or
          (jsonb_typeof(`tasks`.`board_order`->'status') = 'number' and
           `tasks`.`board_order`->>'status' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))
        and (not (`tasks`.`board_order` ? 'priority') or
          (jsonb_typeof(`tasks`.`board_order`->'priority') = 'number' and
           `tasks`.`board_order`->>'priority' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))
        and (not (`tasks`.`board_order` ? 'business') or
          (jsonb_typeof(`tasks`.`board_order`->'business') = 'number' and
           `tasks`.`board_order`->>'business' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))
        and (not (`tasks`.`board_order` ? 'project') or
          (jsonb_typeof(`tasks`.`board_order`->'project') = 'number' and
           `tasks`.`board_order`->>'project' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))

tool_uses_completion_consistent.name: tool_uses_completion_consistent
tool_uses_completion_consistent.value:
(`tool_uses`.`status` = 'completed' and `tool_uses`.`completed_at` is not null)
        or (`tool_uses`.`status` in ('draft', 'open') and `tool_uses`.`completed_at` is null)
        or `tool_uses`.`status` = 'archived'

agenda_entries_entity_consistent.name: agenda_entries_entity_consistent
agenda_entries_entity_consistent.value:
(`agenda_entries`.`entity_kind` = 'project' and `agenda_entries`.`project_id` is not null and `agenda_entries`.`task_id` is null)
        or (`agenda_entries`.`entity_kind` = 'task' and `agenda_entries`.`task_id` is not null and `agenda_entries`.`project_id` is null)
